test_title: PYST 36: SSC GD Constable 2025 - English (Held On: 20 Feb, 2025 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word(s) in the given sentence.

The deer were afraid when they saw a __school of fish__ approaching.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in the sentence lies in the incorrect use of the collective noun "**school of fish**" in the context of deer being afraid.
 
• Deer are more likely to fear predators such as wolves, not fish.
 
• The correct collective noun for wolves is "**pack**," making "**pack of wolves**" the appropriate substitution.
 
• Thus, the correct replacement creates a logical and grammatically sound sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **B**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The deer were afraid when they saw a **pack of wolves** approaching."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A: "herd of lions"** – Incorrect, as lions form a "pride," not a herd.
 
• **C: "swarm of hyenas"** – Incorrect, as hyenas form a "clan," not a swarm.
 
• **D: "flock of buffaloes"** – Incorrect, as buffaloes form a "herd," not a flock.
 
• **Correct usage** – "Pack of wolves" is the accurate collective noun in this context.
